title: Product Service Provider
description: Definition of Product Service Provider under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

content.legal_definition: a person who provides any service in respect of such product
content.plain_language: a person or business that offers services related to a product
examples: a company that repairs mobile phones
non_examples: a company that only manufactures products
a retailer who only sells products

user_queries: What is a product service provider?
Who is considered a product service provider?
What services are included in product service provider?
